name: Autodrom Sosnová v17.0 - Racing Days 5.12.2026
description: Autodrom Sosnová near Česká Lípa, Czech Republic, set up for the Liqui Moly Racing Days of 5.12.2026: the race route of the organiser's map (1678 m, anticlockwise) with a tyre stack at each of its 57 yellow dots, bags and tape along their rows and cones across open asphalt. The circuit is the real one: every piece of asphalt with its real outline and width from the 12.5 cm aerial photo of the Czech state survey, the real concrete strips, sand run-offs and tyre walls, the laser-scanned landscape and buildings. 16 grid slots, 16 pit boxes, lap timing with one sector gate. Data: ČÚZK (CC BY 4.0), materials from Poly Haven (CC0). Optional CSP grass and rain. Not affiliated with the circuit owner or the organiser.
author: Sosnova track kit (data: ČÚZK Ortofoto ČR + DMR 5G, CC BY 4.0)
